title: PNC and IMAS Bring Free STEAM Learning to RGV's Youngest Minds - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago McAllen, TX — The International Museum of Art & Science (IMAS) is pleased to announce a grant from the PNC Foundation in support of early childhood programming and museum access for families. The grant recognizes the museum’s commitment to providing unique, educational experiences for preschool-aged children and their families. This milestone investment in early childhood education has brought free, high-quality programming to young children across the Rio Grande Valley, culminating in two landmark initiatives: the ongoing Young Adventurers STEAM workshop series and PNC Adventure Day which took place on March 18, 2026 bringing over 1,000 visitors to the museum to engage in early learning activities.
